title: 第23章 自己骂自己第24章 时间这么短
slug: 一剑惊天下可她身后的男人更可怕
content_zh:
好了。”
梅映雪收回手指，满意地端详着自己的“杰作”。
“这是‘仙人渡’秘传金光咒中的一种变式——玄冰封元印。有此印在，你那些乱七八糟的念头和冲动，自然会消停不少。”
她语气轻松，随手帮君傲整理了一下衣服。
君傲呆呆地站在原地，低头看着自己身上那个缓缓隐入皮肤的冰蓝印记，又抬头看了看营房简陋的屋顶。
两眼无神。
脑子里只有一个念头：
完了。
全完了。
老子以后……跟太监有什么区别？
梅映雪似乎看出他所想，难得温和地补充了一句：“放心，这封印只封元阳精气，不影响你正常修炼生活。待你日后修为突破至超凡境，体内真气质变，此印自然会被冲开。”
君傲缓缓转过头，眼神空洞地看着她，嘴唇动了动，却没发出声音。
那表情，活像个被抽走了魂魄的木偶。
梅映雪被他这模样逗得差点笑出来，连忙轻咳一声，板起脸：
“快点把裤子穿好。”
她背过身去。
“然后，跟我去军营报道。”
“……报道？”君傲机械地提起裤子，声音干涩，“做什么？”
“从今天起，”梅映雪转过身，脸上已恢复清冷，“你就是镇南军前锋营的一名普通士卒了。吃住训练，皆与旁人无异。没有世子身份，没有特殊照顾。”
她看着君傲那副失魂落魄的样子，微微挑眉：

“怎么，不愿意？”
君傲一个激灵，连忙摇头：“愿意！愿意！娘子……不，将军安排得极好！我、我这就去报道！”
他手忙脚乱地系好腰带，整理衣袍，虽然动作还有些僵硬，眼神却渐渐活了过来。
当兵就当兵吧。
总比……总比当太监强。
梅映雪眼底闪过一丝笑意，转身推开营房门。
“跟上。”
阳光倾泻而入。
君傲深吸一口气，迈步跟了上去。
前路未知。
但至少，他还活着，还能修炼，还能……杀鬼子。
至于别的……
他低头看了看小腹处隐隐传来的冰凉感，欲哭无泪。
算了，超凡境而已。
老子拼了命，也要早点修到！

Mei Yingxue retracted her fingers and looked at her "masterpiece" with satisfaction.
"This is a variation of the 'Immortal Crossing' secret golden light spell - the Xuan Bing Yuan Seal. With this imprint in place, your messy thoughts and impulses will naturally subside a lot. "
She spoke in a relaxed tone and casually helped Jun Ao tidy up his clothes.
Jun Ao stood there blankly, looking down at the ice blue mark on his body that slowly faded into his skin, and then looked up at the simple roof of the barracks.
His eyes were dull.
There is only one thought in my mind:
It's over.
It's all over.
From now on, what will be the difference between me and a eunuch?
Mei Yingxue seemed to understand what he was thinking, and added in a rare gentle tone: "Don't worry, this seal only seals the Yuanyang essence and will not affect your normal cultivation life. When your cultivation reaches the extraordinary realm in the future and your true temperament changes, this seal will naturally be broken away. "
Jun Ao slowly turned his head and looked at her with empty eyes. His lips moved but he made no sound.
That expression looked like a puppet whose soul had been drained away.
Mei Yingxue was so amused by his appearance that she almost laughed. She coughed lightly and straightened her face:
“Hurry up and put your pants on. "
She turned her back.
"Then, follow me to the military camp to report. "
"...Report? "Jun Ao lifted up his pants mechanically, with a dry voice, "What to do? "
"From today on," Mei Yingxue turned around, her face regained its coldness, "you are an ordinary soldier in the forward battalion of the Zhennan Army. Food, accommodation and training are all the same as others. There is no heir status and no special care. "
She looked at Jun Ao's lost look and raised her eyebrows slightly:
"What, you don't want to? "
Jun Ao was excited and shook his head quickly: "Yes! willing! Madam... no, the general arranged it very well! I-I'll report it right away! "
He hurriedly tied his belt and adjusted his robes. Although his movements were still a little stiff, his eyes gradually came to life.
Just be a soldier.
It's better than... it's better than being a eunuch.
A smile flashed in Mei Yingxue's eyes, and she turned around and opened the barracks door.
"Follow up. "
Sunlight pours in.
Jun Ao took a deep breath and followed him.
The road ahead is unknown.
But at least, he is still alive, can still practice, and can...kill Japanese.
As for the rest...
He looked down at the faint cold feeling in his lower abdomen and felt like crying without tears.
Forget it, it’s just the transcendent realm.
I have tried my best to cultivate it as soon as possible!
